title: MapleStory Worlds Basic Creation Guide
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: The official curriculum from Maker interface fundamentals through entities, components, scripts, terrain, UI, data, resources, optimization, services, and publishing-related features.

sections.title: Maker foundations
items: Learn Workspace, Hierarchy, components, starting positions, and initial character properties.
Understand models, map layers, entities, properties, and world instances.

sections.title: Logic and presentation
items: Use scripts, synchronization, execution-space controls, functions, and default events.
Build terrain, movement, effects, UI, data, and resource workflows.

sections.title: Production readiness
items: Apply security and optimization practices before release.
Review game services, test servers, paid content, localization, and publishing needs.

notes: Original MPStorys structured outline verified against the official document on 2026-07-27.
steps: Learn the Maker workspace and hierarchy.
Practice entities, components, properties, and scripts.
Build terrain, UI, data, and resources.
Apply optimization, security, testing, and release guidance.
